title: Tesla shows Roadster with SpaceX thrusters in Texas
excerpt: Tesla demonstrated a new Roadster featuring SpaceX thrusters, using them to leap over multiple company vehicles.
body_html:
Tesla has showcased a new version of its Roadster equipped with SpaceX thrusters during a demonstration event in Texas.

During the presentation, the vehicle utilized its thrusters to leap over several other Tesla models, including a Cybercab, a Cybertruck, a Tesla Semi, a Model Y, and a Model 3.
